tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon and fast-transient signatures motivate resolving trajectory dynamics, but the current rows provide weak discrimination among smooth candidate laws. Acquire the fine trajectory batch as the relevant follow-up; avoid the unrelated nuisance probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Auxiliary high-variance measurements do not directly distinguish the candidate response laws and are explicitly irrelevant.

The five observations have only small H variation and s_grad is always zero; they do not robustly separate horizon-dependent relaxation from a static response or Kelvin–Voigt creep at the required tolerance.
The observations show an approximately linear dependence on u_now, and the available inputs do not identify this nonlinear law.
